arguments.sql: SELECT o.order_date, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = 130 GROUP BY o.id

arguments.subject: Order 130: Receipt and Total
arguments.body:
Dear Calder Fasteners Ltd, 

We received your order no. 130 on 2025-11-15. Its total amount is 95 EUR. 

Best regards, 
Acme Components

with_the_gate.answer: Calder Fasteners Ltd's order 130 was handled.
